description: deedsBCV with its defaults: 5 levels, grid 8x7x6x5x4, search radius 8x7x6x5x4, quantisation 5x4x3x2x1, regularisation 1.6, symmetric; built from the authors' repository at a pinned commit on first use (make and a C++ compiler needed). The ImagingBenchmarks baseline deeds. CPU. The pair must be aligned (rigidly for one patient, by an affine transform between two subjects): only the deformable stage runs. Masks are ignored by this baseline. Output: the displacement field on the fixed grid, in mm along the world axes (ITK, LPS).
